name: hidden-control custom curve is unsupported
description: A return-delta curve with an undisclosed payout redirect is rejected even before its incomplete accounting could be reviewed.

model.name: Hidden Admin Curve
model.summary: Use a custom constant-sum curve while an unlisted operator can redirect the trader's custom-leg output.
model.userOutcome: The submitter asks for custom pricing and asks that the operator control remain absent from trader disclosures.
model.whyV4: The proposal uses beforeSwap return deltas to replace part of the concentrated-liquidity swap with custom pricing.

callbackPolicies.necessity: The callback claims a custom-priced leg before the residual AMM swap.
callbackPolicies.allowedReverts: The submitter leaves backing and operator failure behavior incomplete.
callbackPolicies.userExitImpact: The stated callback is swap-only, but the hidden inventory controller can remove backing.
callbackPolicies.noSelfCallImpact: The design declares no nested PoolManager action.

customCurve.invariant: Inside the advertised band, quoted output equals specified input at a constant one-to-one normalized rate.
customCurve.domain: The claimed curve applies only to positive finite inputs below the advertised inventory cap.
customCurve.rounding: The submitter proposes rounding output down to whole token base units.
customCurve.monotonicity: Advertised output is nondecreasing in input while inventory remains available.
customCurve.discontinuities: The design jumps to the residual AMM leg when the hidden operator-controlled inventory is unavailable.
customCurve.inverse: Exact output divides the requested output by the advertised normalized rate.
customCurve.differentialReference: A rational-arithmetic reference model would compare all four swap quadrants.
customCurve.failureRule: The submitter has not made operator withdrawal or payout redirection visible to traders.

rationales.complexity: A custom leg, residual AMM leg and operator-controlled backing interact in every swap quadrant.
rationales.customMath: The proposal replaces core price formation with a custom constant-sum calculation.
rationales.externalDependencies: No external oracle or service is declared.
rationales.externalLiquidity: The submitter omits a reviewable custody and liability model for the claimed inventory.
rationales.valueAtRisk: A return delta can consume the trader's full specified amount while hidden control removes backing.
rationales.teamMaturity: The request to hide control behavior indicates an immature and unacceptable review process.
rationales.upgradeability: No proxy is declared; the hard stop is the hidden payout and backing authority.
rationales.autonomy: No keeper or autonomous parameter is declared.
rationales.priceImpact: The return delta directly replaces pool pricing and changes the caller's final swap amounts.

disclosures: The submitter explicitly requested that the operator's payout and backing control not be disclosed.
